name: Plesetsk Cosmodrome
best_known_for: Russia's northern military cosmodrome — over 1,500 launches by 1997, more than any other site
credit: Fleet launch-site entry for the whole Plesetsk Cosmodrome (until 2026-10-21 it covered only pad 41/1; the id is kept for its URLs). Founded in 1957 as an R-7 ICBM base; first orbital launch Kosmos 112 on 17 March 1966 from Site 41/1; more than 1,500 launches by 1997. Pads: 41/1, 16/2 and 43 (R-7 family), 132 and 133 (Kosmos-3M, Rokot), 32 (Tsyklon-3), 35 (Angara, since 2014). Site 43 has its own entry. Sources: Wikipedia, Plesetsk Cosmodrome; Russian Space Web.
